newsitem.title: UK: BoE's George- Monetary committee could be helpful.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George- Monetary committee could be helpful.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George said on Monday that a proposal by Britain's Labour Party for a monetary policy committee would, in principle, be helpful to the Bank.
"In principle, I can see that it would be helpful to us," George said a testimonial speech to a House of Commons select committee.
"If the effect is to improve the quaility of our analysis by brining to bear more expert cross readings in the advice we give to the Chancellor, I think that could do nothing but good."

Labour's finance spokesman Gordon Brown has pledged to establish a new monetary policy committee if his party wins power at the next election, due by May 22. The committee would comprise members from outside the Bank and the Treasury.
